title: Wɔn a Wɔkyekyee Adum a Ɛkorɔn no
intro: Wogyina tete kurow kɛse bi amamfõ anim, na afei n’adum a ɛkorɔn ahwe ase. Mframa no bɔ ose wɔ mmɔnten a obiara nni hɔ so, na ɛde nnipa a wɔyɛ den a bere bi na wodi nsase yi so no nkae kɔ. Ná wɔyɛ henanom?
clues: Ná yɛyɛ nnipa a yɛwɔ ahoɔden ne ahokokwaw kɛse, a wonim yɛn sɛ yɛyɛ adan akɛse ne anibuei a ɛkɔ anim.
Ná yɛte asase a anhweatam ne abotan nkoko wɔ so so, na na yegye di sɛ obiara ntumi nni yɛn so nkonim.
Ɔbɔfoɔ bi firii yɛn ankasa abusuafoɔ mu baa yɛn nkyɛn, frɛɛ yɛn sɛ yɛnsom Allah nko ara, nanso yɛpoo na yɛdii ne ho fɛw.
Yɛde yɛn hoahoaa yɛn ho sɛ, ‘Hena na ne ho yɛ den sen yɛn?’ na yɛtoaa yɛn ahomaso ne abosonsom mu.
Allah somaa mframa a ano yɛ den a ɛbɔe anadwo nson ne nnawɔtwe, na ɛde biribiara sɛee.
Na yɛyɛ ‘Ad nkurɔfoɔ, Iram adansifoɔ, na yɛn nkrabea bɛyɛɛ kɔkɔbɔ maa wɔn a wɔdii akyire no nyinaa.

trial.label: Dɛn ne asotwe a wɔde baa wɔn so no?

location.label: Dɛn na wɔfrɛ wɔn kurow a wɔka ho asɛm wɔ anansesɛm mu no?

outcome.label: Dɛn ne wɔn nkrabea a etwa to?
options: Wɔsɛee wɔn na wɔn nkae bɛyɛɛ asuade
Wonu wɔn ho na wɔgyee wɔn nkwa
Wɔmenee wɔn wɔ ɛpo no mu
Wosiee wɔn wɔ asase a abubu ase
outcome.answer: Wɔsɛee wɔn na wɔn nkae bɛyɛɛ asuade

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
